items.darija: كل خنفوس عند مو غزال، وانتا عندي أحسن واحد.
items.latin: kol khenfous 3nd mmou ghzal, w nta 3ndi a7sen wa7ed.
items.meaning_en: Every child is beautiful to the one who loves them, and to me you're the best.

items.darija: اليد الوحدة ما كتصفقش، عاونو بعضياتكم.
items.meaning_en: You can't do it alone, help each other.
Nothing beats home; even the worst of home is better than the best abroad.

items.darija: الجار قبل الدار، شوف شكون ساكن حداك.
items.meaning_en: The neighbors matter more than the house, see who lives next to you.

items.darija: باب النجار مخلوع، باك طبيب وهو ديما مريض.
items.latin: bab nnjjar makhlou3, bak tbib w houwa dima mrid.
items.meaning_en: The cobbler's children go barefoot: your dad is a doctor and he's always sick.

items.darija: الكلمة الزوينة كتخرج الحنش من غارو.
items.latin: lkelma zwina katkhrrej l7nech mn gharou.
items.meaning_en: A kind word can win over anyone.

items.latin: khouk drbni w bka, sb9ni w chka!
items.meaning_en: Your brother hit me and then cried, he complained before I could! (he plays the victim, playful)
They blamed the wrong person (a scapegoat).

items.latin: ma t7zench a wlidi, ddenya dwwara.
items.meaning_en: Don't be sad, my boy, life turns around (things will change).

items.darija: فين هاد الغيبة أبنتي؟ ما بقيتيش كتبان!
items.latin: fin had lghiba a benti? ma b9itich katbani!
items.meaning_en: Where have you been, my girl? We never see you anymore! (affectionate reproach)
It's been so long since I heard your voice.

items.latin: koul a wlidi, rak d3efti bzaf.
items.meaning_en: Eat, my boy, you've lost so much weight.

items.darija: واش نسيتي ميمتك؟ ما عيطتيش من العيد.
items.latin: wach nsiti mimtek? ma 3eyyetti mn l3id.
items.meaning_en: Have you forgotten your grandma (me)? You haven't called since Eid.
You little rascal, where were you? You had me worried! (affectionate)

items.darija: عواشرك مبروكة أوليدي، الله يعاودها عليك.
items.meaning_en: Happy Eid, my boy, may you celebrate many more.

items.darija: عمك أحمد مات البارح، البركة فراسكم.
items.latin: 3emmek a7med mat lbare7, lbaraka f raskom.
items.meaning_en: Your uncle Ahmed passed away yesterday, my condolences to you all.

items.darija: لا باس عليك؟ سمعت كنتي مريض.
items.meaning_en: Are you okay? I heard you were sick.

items.latin: imta ghadi nfer7 bik a wlidi?
items.meaning_en: When will I see you get married, my boy?

items.darija: تغدينا مزيان عند مك، الله يعمرها دار.
items.latin: tgheddina mzyan 3nd mmek, llah y3emmerha dar.
items.meaning_en: We had a lovely lunch at your mom's, bless her home.

items.darija: صافي، ما تبقاش تصيفط الفلوس، راه عندي اللي يكفيني.
items.latin: safi, ma tb9ach tsifet lflous, rah 3ndi lli ykfini.
items.meaning_en: That's enough, stop sending money, I have all I need.
You're not sick by any chance? Your voice sounds different.
So you're French now, are you? You've forgotten Darija! (teasing)
I'm waiting for you to come this summer.

items.latin: ntiya a wlidi dima f bali.
items.meaning_en: You're always on my mind, my boy.

items.darija: العام الجاي إن شاء الله نشوفك.
items.meaning_en: Hopefully I'll see you next year.
Put the phone down and go study.
My heart goes out to you, is work very tiring?

items.darija: الله يهديك، علاش ما لبستيش الكبوط؟ البرد!
items.latin: llah yhdik, 3lach ma lbstich lkebbout? lberd!
items.meaning_en: Oh come on, why didn't you wear your coat? It's cold!
I sent the homemade olive oil with your uncle.

items.darija: الكار ديال الصباح مشا، غادي نشد ديال العشية.
items.latin: lkar dyal sbah mcha, ghadi nched dyal l3chiya.
items.meaning_en: I missed the morning bus, I'll take the afternoon one.
Your grandpa had his tests done, everything is fine.
